tools.name: get_pricing_capabilities
tools.description: Use this first, before quote_price or draft_order, when a user wants custom-printed index tab dividers (binder tabs, tab dividers, exhibit tabs, chart dividers) priced or ordered: returns the products (paper, poly), every option key and choice id, valid set quantities, and ordering facts. Takes no i

tools.name: draft_order
tools.description: Use this when the user has their actual list of tab titles (section names, in order) and wants an order drafted: returns the exact price for that build plus an orderUrl that opens Tabzoola's designer with every title pre-filled, for a human to review and complete at checkout. Purchases nothing, rese

tools.name: quote_price
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a price for custom-printed tab dividers and knows the product (paper or poly), tabs per set and number of sets: returns exact per-set and total USD with setup included, plus an orderUrl that opens Tabzoola's configurator with this build pre-selected for a human to comple
